payload.summary: Medication and therapy records carry zero source links while their footers tell the clinician to check the linked source
payload.detail: /medications/[slug] has 0 anchors in <main> on all four tabs; /therapy-compass/[slug] the same. Footer on every tab: 'verify every dose and interaction against the linked source'. acamprosate states Max 1998 mg/day, a serum creatinine >120 micromol/L contraindication, Half-life 13-28.4 h and an unattributed EFFICACY: MODERATE tile; the only provenance is one prose sentence on tab 4 below the fold. Root cause: medication-records.ts:118-126 derives governance from a free-text src section with no URL or document id. /dictionary and /factsheets do this correctly. Fixing properly is a database migration plus clinical governance.
